title: Yummy Leaf-Wrapped Turkish Dates Wrap
description: Sweet, herbal dates wrapped in aromatic tea leaves, dusted with cinnamon and flamed with honey for a comforting dessert.
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium heat and lightly oil it with olive oil.
In a bowl, mix almond butter, chopped pistachios, ground cinnamon, salt, and rose water until smooth.
Slice each date in half lengthwise and fill with the almond mixture, then press to seal.
Place the filled dates in the skillet and cook for 2 minutes on each side until lightly browned.
Drizzle honey over the dates and sprinkle sugar on top, then use a lighter to briefly flame the honey until it caramelizes but be careful not to burn.
While the dates are still hot, gently roll each date in a tea leaf to coat completely, using the leaf as a wrap.
Arrange the wrapped dates on a platter and dust with dried rose petals for extra aroma.
Garnish with mint leaves on top and serve immediately while warm.
